title: I had Claude help me make a high quality web game
author: Trashy_io
selftext:
I will start of by saying it wasn't easy but if you are on the edge of making games or not id say go for it! You might not like but guess what you tried! 

I am at a point in the journey where some time away might be the best option and re group I had made this as a last hope to get some form of income from the game dev side of things and be able to keep working on my skills. But the industry is only getting harder to break through and you have to be on point with everything which is great, but makes it tuff doing things solo. 

I would suggest on focusing on one area at a time and trying to "specialize" in that and building on top of that and specializing in the next department. A long process but is the only way I have gotten the results I have now. 

Most of the people who are having success have legit 4-10+ years of experience in the industry, so don't feel bad you haven't figured it out yet. Just take it step by step! 

Ill also add taking the time to learn game dev and AI separately is another big thing that helped me not all at once. Best of luck to everyone out on the journey as well and hope you try out Cue Fusion, I could use some fresh eyes and feedback on it! 

WF:  
Build plan   
Prototype build   
Assets as I need them   
Test, Test, Test 

I use AI for repetitive and simple edits, and think maintaining the amount of responsibility to a relatively low amount per prompt is a huge boost on token efficiency!
